decisions.title: Throughput policy: wall is the law
Mainnet home: Bittensor netuid 91
Provisioner rules of escalation: deadline-bounded ladder walking, 2x floor
Cascade promotion: persist the king, never vacate the throne
Cascade warm-start: revert on testnet, sequence reign-clock determinism before consumption
Heat screen: LCB machinery is a diagnostic, never the selection rule
Pre-heat content dedup on EXACT identity only; similarity threshold removed; LLM judge stays advisory
CRPS half of the round metric is a per-window geomean, not a pooled MWSQL
Host variance is MEASURED, not normalized — host telemetry is diagnostic only
Heat standings publish when the heat settles, mirrored publicly per round
Finalist count responds to the screen's own statistic; the tied cohort all duel under a family-wise alpha
Warm-start promotes a top-k member set; the trainer selects, validators verify an envelope
From-scratch signal survives the warm-start era: shadow control first, reseed valve second, a second throne only on divergent-winners evidence
Promotion members are selected by measured error decorrelation within the quality frontier; cascade_top_k=5 deferred to a coordinated release
The dethrone margin decays with the king's tenure: reuse the affine warmup schedule in reverse, armed at release (owner-collapsed from release-then-activate)
Promotion never ratchets the shared init downhill: a ripe reign with only worse-benching candidates holds the live generation
Warm-start recipe: WSD learning-rate schedule (warmup once per generation, flat across rounds) + optimizer-state continuity in the checkpoint
The per-round eval draw is jittered — composition unpredictable, equal-weight per domain in expectation, block-gated activation
The submission carrier becomes an extensible series record — settled once, payload-free, before any gap opens
Time anchor (start, freq): reserved in the carrier now, consumed by nothing — the fixed model is calendar-free by pinned architecture
The length cap does not foreclose long-range priors — long CONTEXT is deferred to the 22M size seam and costed there
Missingness is a parallel mask field with pinned filler — never NaN — and it is eval-gated: the pool must carry real gaps before the field is accepted
For the pinned architecture, a panel IS a variate group — group_id stays reserved; panel capability rides the multivariate arm
Corpus-level non-stationarity needs nothing beyond the time anchor — and the model cannot perceive it anyway; yield order is the one drift lever miners already hold
Multivariate arms eval-first: per-series C with bucketed batching, full-freight channel pricing, roles as a record field — and the channel-drop trap is fixed before any cap raise
Scaling past ~300M params: per-size GPU pins, size-conditional provisioning (300M+ rents H100), and a warm-start round pipeline — from-scratch-per-round ends between 22M and 100M
Real data enters (if ever) as ONE owner-pinned shared corpus generators read — the ceiling is restated no-shipped-DATA, and the machinery ships inert so arming is a config edit
Fork-anneal: every training run ends with a cosine decay branch — scoring layers see finished-form checkpoints, the lineage continues mid-stable
Bench-anneal: the benchmark sidecar scores an annealed copy of each duel checkpoint — finished-form BenchScores with zero validator involvement

GP-prior generation economics: the materialised corpus budget is denominated in POINTS (count free), the batch drain budget rises 1800 → 7200 CPU-s with the streaming stall window split off and pinned, and the relative-jitter Cholesky is documented miner-side
Even-by-domain eval draws: pool capacity floors per domain + tightened mix jitter (alpha 4 -> 28), coordinated block-gated activation
The measured variance bundle: EMA finished-form checkpoints, N-seed generation mix, warm-started re-warmup — shipped inert behind drop-when-default
Init-baseline: a null baseline for KOTH — heat shadow row + duel-side dethrone floor (gift-gate shaped), shipped off
Toto2-aligned optimizer constants + warm-start LR scale — the measured recipe that beats the converged init, shipped inert behind drop-when-default
Miner-funded challenger legs under elastic-cadence rounds; king and confirmation legs stay operator-funded
Duel-only rounds on the operator's final fleet: no heat, the whole field seats in reveal order, the fleet sizes to the epoch, one block-gated flip with the scored horizon ladder
Cohort duel family-wise correction: a shared-resample studentised max-T, not Bonferroni α/k — exact under the challengers' real correlation, block-gated
Arm the increment margin, block-gated: a maturing lineage's dethrone bar prices a fraction of the per-round increment, not the king's absolute score

Make the king beatable more often by flattening the fresh-king margin ramp (win_margin_start → the floor), NOT by touching the LCB noise gate: the margin below ~0.3% is inert because the paired-bootstrap LCB>0 requirement binds first

Multivariate scoring for the private-pool duel is GIFT-Eval-weighted (per-variate metric, a window counts ONCE with its channels averaged in) and lands eval-first: the round point statistic is made to agree with the source-cluster bootstrap, block-gated and bit-identical on the univariate pool

Multivariate advantage by construction: batches are 64 SERIES at every width, the token budget is denominated in series-points (a C-channel corpus trains C× the tokens in the same step count), and the wall grows to 5h while the budget stays the 3h figure — the wall stays the law

Rolling intake + era king: challengers train the moment they are funded, verdicts settle on a 3h grid, the king's leg is trained once per 12h era and cached — every behaviour change block-gated at ONE rollover

Rolling top-k promotion: live members compete with the reign's candidates for the same k slots; a candidate enters only by beating the worst live member, and a promotion fires only when membership changes

Stake-weighted activation: validators signal readiness on chain, the DEC-CA-0043 rollover locks in at the first boundary where 51% of eligible validator stake has signalled and flips at the next boundary — no typed-in block

Token billing with a proportional width bonus: budget_denomination = \"points+mv<PCT>\" bills every channel and discounts C > 1 series by 100/(100+PCT), so the budget (not the wall, not the GPU drawn) decides every leg's tokens
King forfeiture + admission denylist: a listed hotkey leaves the throne and the court at a set block (consensus, release-then-activate); the trainer refuses its admissions and never trains it as king
Dethrone bar v2: increment-unit margin 0.4 for a fresh king, decaying to 0.2 over 18000 blocks of tenure — decided on chain by validator readiness (DEC-CA-0045), typed block = owner override

v2 incentive mechanism: Cascade-MOE-28M king lineage (lane A) + a concurrent domain-expert lane (lane B) that trains a frozen-router expert subset for one tsbench-forge domain, merges into the king, and pays on a 5-round decay

Port the chain layer to bittensor 11.3.0 with 10.5 bit-compatibility: reveal encoding via bittensor_core (never timelock.encrypt), stake from the typed metagraph (float32, == 10.5 S), weights float32-cast before u16 quantisation

Direct ~220M MoE runs on cascade's infrastructure: miner-chosen Lium/Vast/RunPod pods on the payer's own key, SSH dispatch with orchestrator harvest to Hippius, emission rewards, and validators that check the trainer's signed scores instead of evaluating

Generation moves off the GPU pod: an operator-run CPU tier on Targon and Shadeform materialises each leg's corpus into a tagged Hippius dataset, metered in CPU budget instead of GPU feed rate; series lengths up to ~32k behind a scheduled context

A dethrone must also not regress on public benchmarks: no suite of GIFT-Eval / BOOM / TIME significantly worse on a paired test, and the six-number geomean strictly better — read from trainer-signed per-item rows

v2 launch economics: 95% pre-launch burn, the carried king capped at 5% until a v2 crowning, a 7-day random-init window before the reign clock starts, king-only self-improvement promotions, a lane-A share ladder (new king at a margin-tiered start, 25-80% by its crowning LCB, 50% in level units; +10% per verified warm start up to 95%, a failed check drops to 10%; the last former king 5% for 5 days), and the king funds its own leg (a failing key slashes it to 1%, escalating: >= 6 eras for a first lapse, the rest of the reign for a second)

Lane C: miner-funded fine-tune recipes on the king checkpoint, per-target, judged on a separate per-target eval, paid in per-target slots; emissions A 50 / B 25 / C 25 once armed (50 / 50 / 0 until then)

Verdict and payout constants ship as an owner-signed network config, adopted by stake (51 %) and applied at its era-start effective block; validators update only for new code, locked training terms or security roots

One owner main validator scores; satellite validators replay its signed receipts (verdict, ladder, lanes, weights) from the recorded rows and set the vector that replay produces — no model, no pool, no torch
Lane B legs may declare up to 3 domains: one jointly trained checkpoint over the union of the declared domains' experts, each domain judged and paid separately (alpha/k), merged once
Every leg keeps the same token budget; a miner may choose which GPU type (and later how many GPUs) its own key rents, trading money for speed, never for compute

Lane A public gate: four suites (GIFT-Eval, BOOM, TIME, FEV); rule v2 (2026-10-20) avg_noninf_winrate — per task, better on average, no suite significantly worse, win rate >= 0.5; the private pool still decides by geomean LCB
Lane D: a distillation / real-data lane — wired as an inert placeholder (config table, wiring points), details to be filled in by the owner

Lane-A public benchmarks run on the main validator's GPU, and only for a challenger that has already won the private pool (plus the king and the init it is compared with). Other validators and satellites read the main validator's signed report.

MarketCast: a lane-C fine-tune eval on a pinned Timestral-28M base, judged paired vs the untouched base on forward-only market windows, one lane-C slot per suite (mkt:returns, mkt:vol, …); built (pool, trainer, validator, audit, intake), shipped off at from_block = 0
